def get_overlaps(interval_a, interval_b):
    starts = sorted([interval_a[0], interval_b[0]], reverse=True)
    ends = sorted([interval_a[1], interval_b[1]], reverse=True)
    
    max_overlap = -inf
    for si, ei in zip(starts, ends):
        if ei <= si:
            continue
        max_overlap = max(max_overlap, ei)
